title: Chain Safe Calls
instructions:
A `RobotConfig` data class has a nullable `teamName` property of type `String?`.

Write a function called `getTeamNameUpperCase` that takes a `config` parameter of type `RobotConfig?` and returns a `String`.

Use chained safe calls to get the team name and convert it to uppercase. If anything is null, return `"NO TEAM"`.

For example:
- `getTeamNameUpperCase(RobotConfig("Tribots"))` returns `"TRIBOTS"`
- `getTeamNameUpperCase(RobotConfig(null))` returns `"NO TEAM"`
- `getTeamNameUpperCase(null)` returns `"NO TEAM"`
hint: Chain safe calls like `config?.teamName?.uppercase()` and use `?: "NO TEAM"` for the default. The `uppercase()` function converts a String to all capital letters.
